title: SQL
story_intro: Professor Byte sends you to Ledgerhold, a city built of libraries. The Null Plague has scrambled its records, and the first Key of the Dragon's Castle is hidden in the city archive. Learn SQL to read, fix, and connect the records.
story_outro: Archivist Null crumbles into clean data and hands you the Key of Records. The city's restored lanterns light the road to Emberwood.

title: Python
story_intro: The lanterns of Emberwood have gone dark, and only small programs can relight them. The second Key lies in the heart of the forest. Learn Python to light the way.
story_outro: The Infinite Treant finally stops growing and gives you the Key of Fire. Beyond the trees rise the Cog Cliffs.

title: DSA in Python
story_intro: The Cog Cliffs are a mountain of clockwork puzzles. Slow solutions slip off the ledges, so only clever and fast ones can climb. Learn data structures and algorithms to reach the third Key.
story_outro: The Summit Sphinx admits you were faster than its riddle and hands over the Key of Speed. In the distance a tower flickers in and out of time.

title: Git and GitHub
story_intro: Every floor of Chrono Tower holds an older version of the same castle. Learn Git to move through time, branch off, and merge without losing a single day of work.
story_outro: The Time Warden returns the tower to the present and gives you the Key of Versions. A messenger road leads away from the tower.

title: Flask and APIs
story_intro: In Courier Kingdom the messages never reach the right door. Learn Flask and APIs to build routes the couriers can follow.
story_outro: The Royal Router bows and gives you the Key of Routes. Ahead lies a harbour full of broken signs.

title: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
story_intro: The signs of Pixel Harbour are crooked and its buttons do nothing. Rebuild the harbour with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
story_outro: The Pixel Troll admires your layout and gives you the Key of Design. A strange marsh glows to the south.

title: ML Basics
story_intro: In Mirror Marsh a creature learns by memorising instead of understanding. Learn how models are trained and tested so you can teach it properly.
story_outro: The Overfit Beast finally learns the pattern, not the answers, and gives you the Key of Patterns. An ancient temple rises from the fog.

title: Gen AI
story_intro: The oracle of Prompt Temple answers only well-made requests. Learn to write clear prompts that get useful answers.
story_outro: The Riddle Oracle answers plainly for the first time in a thousand years and gives you the Key of Words. A castle gate waits ahead.

title: HR and Communication
story_intro: The guards of Interview Castle ask about you, not about code. Learn to explain your skills and your work clearly and calmly.
story_outro: The Castle Guard salutes and hands over the ninth Key, the Key of Voice. Only the dragon remains.

title: Final Boss
story_intro: You hold nine Keys. The Hiring Dragon guards the Golden Offer Letter and will ask everything you have learned: queries, code, APIs, prompts, and your own words. Stay calm and answer well.
story_outro: The Hiring Dragon lowers its head and hands you the Golden Offer Letter. Your quest is complete.
